purpose: Load only trusted current SQL/SSM/pinned-TLS runtime state, reconcile selected routes, and run a bounded-expiry operator gateway

initialRepairedFailures: Fixture TLS overload and raw socket types required the existing GatewayTlsDial and Duplex interfaces.
SQL integration fixture initially used a nonexistent grant setter; now uses the existing grantUse/revokeUse methods.
Preload fixture moved to ESM for lint and uses a file URL for Windows --import compatibility.

limitations: Process expiry stops serving, not AWS billing; durable owned-resource teardown remains required.
The launcher still must compose AWS task/network observation, source preflight/recheck, registration and activation.
Standalone process registry/SSM/platform transport is explicitly fake; TLS, HTTP serving and expiry are real.
Real PostgreSQL/TLS integration mocks SSM and document storage; no AWS IAM/ingress or hosted proof is implied.
No provisioning, worker start, migrations, flags, connection change, invitation email or production release.
